title: AMC 10 Practice: Subset With No Double or Triple — Chessboard Trick
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on the largest subset of 1 to 100 with no number double or triple another, solved with a chessboard-style grid and dominoes. (Level 5 of 5)
Pick as many numbers from 1 to 100 as you can, but never a number and its double or its triple. How big can your set be? Vantee turns it into a chessboard and shows two ways to prove the answer.
